contrast_sweep.question: Does quotient recovery improve monotonically when environment-induced observable contrast increases?

acceptance_categories.failure: no meaningful recovery or likelihood benefit
acceptance_categories.partial_recovery: ARI/NMI clearly improve over Stage 2A.1 ceiling but miss strong threshold
acceptance_categories.predictive_only: NLL improves while ARI remains low
acceptance_categories.strong_recovery: ARI/NMI >= 0.80, active >= K - 1, dNLL_known small, no ARI/NMI selection
